metadata_description: Display metadata and physical unit mappings for the 40 whitelisted XGBoost baseline features.

T_mean_t.description: Mean cargo core temperature across active container probes at current timestamp.

spatial_range_t.description: Difference between hottest and coldest probe in the cargo container at current timestamp.

spatial_std_t.description: Standard deviation across active spatial cargo probes at current timestamp.

hot_ratio_t.description: Fraction of active probes measuring elevated temperatures.

cold_ratio_t.description: Fraction of active probes measuring sub-optimal low temperatures.

mask_ratio_t.description: Ratio of valid active sensors relative to total channel capacity.

W60_T_mean.description: Rolling mean temperature over the backward 60-minute window [t-50m, t].

W60_T_std.description: Rolling standard deviation of temperature over the backward 60-minute window.

W60_T_min.description: Minimum temperature recorded in the cargo container over the past hour.

W60_T_max.description: Peak temperature reached in the cargo container over the past hour.

W60_T_median.description: Median temperature level over the backward 60-minute window.

W60_T_q25.description: 25th percentile temperature over the backward 60-minute window.

W60_T_q75.description: 75th percentile temperature over the backward 60-minute window.

W60_T_iqr.description: Difference between 75th and 25th percentile temperatures over past hour.

W60_T_range.description: Difference between maximum and minimum temperature in past hour.

W60_delta.description: Net temperature change from t-50m to t: T(t) - T(t-50m).

W60_slope.description: Linear rate of warming or cooling over the past hour: Delta / 50 min.

W60_acceleration.description: Second-order rate of change of temperature slope over the past hour.

W60_spatial_range_mean.description: Rolling mean of container spatial temperature range over past hour.

W60_spatial_range_max.description: Maximum spatial temperature spread across probes observed in past hour.

W60_spatial_std_mean.description: Rolling mean of spatial temperature standard deviation over past hour.

W60_hot_ratio_mean.description: Rolling average proportion of hot probe readings in past hour.

W60_hot_ratio_max.description: Maximum proportion of probes concurrently in elevated state in past hour.

W60_cold_ratio_mean.description: Rolling average proportion of cold probe readings in past hour.

W60_cold_ratio_max.description: Maximum proportion of probes concurrently in cold state in past hour.

W60_mask_ratio_mean.description: Rolling average sensor channel availability over past hour.

W60_mask_ratio_min.description: Lowest sensor channel availability recorded in past hour.

sconf.description: Composite sensor health and packet completeness score.

coverage_points.description: Number of reporting temperature probes at current timestamp.

coverage_time.description: Fraction of expected packet transmissions successfully received.

N_valid.description: Total count of valid non-corrupt probe measurements.

v4_p95_t.description: 95th percentile temperature across container probes at current timestamp.

v4_p90_t.description: 90th percentile temperature across container probes at current timestamp.

v4_slope_long_t.description: Extended-window linear rate of temperature change across container probes.

v4_shock_t.description: Sudden temperature shift metric capturing thermal shocks.

v4_median_t.description: Median temperature across active container probes at current timestamp.

W60_over_auc_mean.description: Rolling cumulative thermal area above warning threshold in past hour.

W60_spatial_std_max.description: Maximum spatial standard deviation across probes observed in past hour.

v4_spatial_range_t.description: Instantaneous spatial span across container probes (v4 feature set).

v4_spatial_std_t.description: Instantaneous standard deviation across container probes (v4 feature set).

v4_iqr_t.description: Instantaneous interquartile range across spatial probes.

v4_hot_ratio_t.description: Instantaneous hot probe ratio (v4 feature set).

v4_cold_ratio_t.description: Instantaneous cold probe ratio (v4 feature set).

v4_accel_t.description: Instantaneous rate of change of 10-minute slope.

v4_sconf_t.description: Instantaneous packet integrity and probe confidence score.
